biggest_catch: Teachers set their own price, but italki keeps a 15% commission on every completed lesson and withdrawals go out only twice a month.
catches: italki takes a 15% commission on every completed lesson (no commission on trial lessons).
Teacher balance withdrawals are processed only twice a month - not instant.
Payment-provider fees apply on withdrawal (e.g. ~2% for PayPal; rates differ by country).
Earnings are self-employment income - you report your own taxes.
This is a marketplace: pay depends on finding and keeping students; competition is heavy.

c1.evidence: italki official materials state community tutors set rates starting at $5 per lesson (30-60 min) and professional teachers at $10 per lesson; lessons listed up to $120.

c2.evidence: italki official Teacher Handbook: withdrawals are processed twice a month - requests submitted 1st-15th are sent 16th-26th; requests 16th-30/31st are sent 1st-10th of the next month.

c3.evidence: Applying as a teacher is free; no upfront fee documented.

c4.evidence: Official concrete per-lesson pay floors, official 30-60 min lesson duration, and official twice-monthly payout timing.

eligibility: Apply as a teacher; upload an introduction video and verification documents; upload teaching certificates for the Professional Teacher track.
maximize: From italki's own Teacher Handbook: set a reasonable price - the handbook recommends new teachers price 20-30% below the average for their language and lesson type; offer lesson times during students' peak hours for your target language; and participate in the italki Community for exposure. Pricing, scheduling, and self-promotion are all legal and within italki's terms.
notes: Rates are teacher-set and vary by language, lesson type, and teacher track; $5 per 30-60 min lesson is the official floor for community tutors. Trials lessons carry no italki commission. Rates 'up to $120 per lesson' reported from italki's own site; actual earnings depend on bookings.
numeric_basis: $5/lesson official floor for 30-60 min community-tutor lessons; $10/lesson professional floor; ~$120/lesson official-quoted maximum; 15% commission deducted from completed lessons
payout_quote: Official teacher materials: community tutors from $5 per lesson, professional teachers from $10 per lesson; italki takes 15% commission on completed lessons (no commission on trials).
payout_value_note: Per-lesson earnings before the 15% italki commission and provider withdrawal fees

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per booked lesson; no bookings, no pay

steps: Apply as a teacher and complete verification (intro video, ID; certificates for Professional Teacher track).
Set your lesson prices and availability.
Earnings land in your teacher wallet; withdraw twice monthly per the official schedule.
timing: Withdrawals processed twice a month: requests 1st-15th sent 16th-26th; requests 16th-30/31st sent 1st-10th of next month (official Teacher Handbook).
who_pays: Students pay for lessons; italki takes a 15% commission on every completed lesson (no commission on trial lessons) and the rest lands in your teacher wallet.
who_qualifies: Apply as a teacher; upload an introduction video and verification documents. Teaching certificates are required for the Professional Teacher track. Community tutors set rates from $5 per lesson, professional teachers from $10 per lesson; lessons run 30-60 minutes.
work_available: This is a marketplace: pay depends on finding and keeping students, and competition is heavy. Students booking you is not guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: Completed lessons only - a completed lesson lands in your teacher wallet minus the 15% commission.
costs_and_unpaid_time: 15% commission on every completed lesson; no upfront fee. Payment-provider fees apply on withdrawal (e.g. ~2% for PayPal; rates differ by country). Withdrawals are processed only twice a month, so cash arrives slowly. Earnings are self-employment income - you report your own taxes.
when_cash_arrives: Teacher balance withdrawals are processed only twice a month: requests submitted 1st-15th are sent 16th-26th; requests submitted 16th-30th/31st are sent 1st-10th of the next month (official Teacher Handbook).
